verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mangopay's wallet split-funds infrastructure, plus AI-developer aids (llms.txt, OpenAPI spec, a docs MCP server). None of it documents agent-initiated checkout, agentic-commerce protocol support, or delegated payment credentials for agent buyers. Those aids are adjacent developer tooling, not the agent-buyer checkout capability, so the story is unevidenced even though the axis applies to a payments platform.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform is ready for agent buyers — documented support for agent-initiated checkout on marketplace transactions (agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials) that works with split funds flows
